notes:
Customer: boutique financial analytics firm with large unstructured research corpus (clients reports, analyst notes, call transcripts). Primary objective: fast, deterministic enterprise search with relevance tuning (reranking) + strict residency. Wants turnkey connector story — minimize engineering lift.

Key quotes: "Need 99th pctile query latency < 150ms for single-vector re-rank, ideally <100ms for top-K search." "We're cost sensitive — target blended cost per user query <$0.01, prefer per-query + monthly commitment."

Current infra: Postgres OLTP + feature store. Evaluating vector DBs: Pinecone (pilot), Elastic (trial), pgvector (internal infra team likes PG ops footprint). Concerned about index rebuild time and incremental sync for nightly ingestion (~2M docs/day during earnings season).

SE notes: prefer HNSW for recall, but want deterministic reranker using smaller dense embeddings + cross-encoder on top. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations: quantization profiles, batching/caching for reranker.

Operational ask: connector must support checkpointed backfills, metadata filters on ingestion, hybrid search (keyword + vector), multi-tenant index separation, and ability to export vector snapshots for audit.

CRM style items: short, choppy bullets in calls; client asks for example SLOs and cost calc per 10Q ingestion cycle. Linked artifacts and threads present.
connector_requirements: bulk import: S3-based bulk loader with manifest and incremental checkpointing
incremental sync: CDC-friendly or timestamp-based delta ingestion
metadata filters: boolean and range filtering at query time
hybrid-search support: allow keyword boosts + vector retrieval
schema mapping: preserve doc-level metadata (client-id, compliance tags)
snapshot/export: periodic flat-file export for audits
scale: 10M+ vectors per index, multi-shard, dynamic re-shard capability
latency: index must support <100ms p99 for top-K approximate search at 50 qps
compatibility: vector dims 768/1024, cosine & dot products, HNSW tuning knobs exposed
indexing_scale: expect initial 3-5M vectors, seasonal spikes to 12M+ during earnings cycles
latency_targets: top-K retrieval p95 < 80ms, p99 < 150ms; reranker end-to-end p99 < 300ms (target 200ms)
qps_targets: steady-state 30-60 qps; burst up to 200 qps for 10 minutes during report releases
cost_constraints: target blended cost per query <$0.01 (including retrieval + rerank); open to reserved capacity pricing for Dedicated
po_requirements: enterprise PO and SLAs; legal needs data residency clause and KMS attestations
notes_for_sales_playbook: Target play: 2-week scaling POC using pgvector connector + Redwood reranker. Show cost model for retrieval+rerank at 3 scale points (3M, 6M, 12M). Emphasize hybrid-search and audit/export features. Bring legal sample KMS/SOC2 doc. Consider Dedicated capacity offer to meet p99 SLOs and predictable unit economics.
